subject: Processor ownership & EU egress path clarification - ClearData.ai
messages:
From: Tim Walsh <t.walsh@cleardata.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-10T09:13:00Z
Subject: Processor ownership and EU egress path for RDW-2347

Hi Marissa / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of our procurement security review I need a concise map of which third-party processors Redwood uses for request routing, logging, and CDN/edge caching when a tenant is pinned to the EU region. Specifically:

- Which processors handle live request routing (by name and country of operation)?
- Where are KV caches and telemetry routed (EU-only or cross-border to US)?
- Any planned changes in the next 90 days that would affect residency or transfer safeguards?

Can you also attach an up-to-date spreadsheet listing processor ownership, purpose, country, and SOC2/SCC evidence links? We need this to complete our legal/compliance sign-off.

Appreciate a reply by EOD Friday if possible — procurement has a gating milestone.

Thanks,
Tim Walsh
Head of Security Operations
ClearData.ai
Attachments: security_questionnaire.pdf (form)
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Walsh <t.walsh@cleardata.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-10T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Processor ownership and EU egress path for RDW-2347

Tim — thanks for the clear list of asks. We're pulling together the matrix now. Quick notes up front:

- We have a dedicated EU edge + CDN (EuroEdge) that handles customer-facing request routing and caching for EU-pinned tenants.
- Observability pipelines (metrics/traces) currently fan out to our centralized LogStream service; depending on the tenant configuration telemetry may transit through our US logging cluster.
- There's a planned exchange of a transient cache partner (EdgeFlow -> CacheWave) for performance reasons; that affects only edge caching and not persistence.

Kimberly — can you attach the latest processor matrix and flag any items that will cause cross-border transfer? Jordan, loop in legal if you see DPA/contract gaps.

I'll follow up once we have the spreadsheet attached and the SOC2 references included.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Lead, Account Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tim Walsh <t.walsh@cleardata.ai>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-11T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Processor ownership and EU egress path for RDW-2347

Hi all — attaching the matrix you requested (subprocessor_matrix_v2.xlsx). Summary below (short version):

- EuroEdge CDN (Operated by EuroEdge Ltd, NL): primary request routing + caching for EU tenants — all cache nodes are inside EU regions; no user payload is persisted outside EU. SOC2 Type II available: https://drive.google.com/edge-evidence

- LogStream (Redwood-managed, US-hosted): collects anonymized operational telemetry (metrics + aggregated traces). For customers that opt into short-term debug logging we may route full logs to LogStream-US for 7-day retention; otherwise logs are scrubbed/aggregated and kept in EU by default. SOC2 + encryption attestation included in the sheet.

- EdgeFlow (transient cache partner, APAC/US footprint) — planned decommission: we will replace EdgeFlow with CacheWave on 2028-06-01. This will not change where persisted customer content resides, but may change transient egress routes for cache misses during the migration window.

- KMS/HSM: Key material for EU-pinned tenants is configured to use our EU KMS by default; HSM vendor is listed with attestations.

Notes/asks:
- Tim, for procurement sign-off can you confirm whether anonymized telemetry routed to LogStream-US is acceptable under your policy? If not we can scope a config that forces EU-only telemetry for your tenants.
- I've flagged CacheWave as "pending contract" in the sheet — contract & SCCs inbound from procurement next week.

Attachments: subprocessor_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Tim Walsh <t.walsh@cleardata.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-12T14:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Processor ownership and EU egress path for RDW-2347

Thanks Kimberly — the matrix is helpful. A couple follow-ups from our security questionnaire (attached):

- We need confirmation whether any of the processors listed have personnel or legal entities in APAC that could trigger cross-border access under local law (even if data nodes are in EU).
- Please provide SOC2 report IDs or vendor attestations for CacheWave once you have them.
- For LogStream-US: we cannot accept full-log egress to the US for EU-regulated tenants. Can you confirm Redwood can enforce EU-only telemetry for ClearData's tenants?

If you can get a DPA addendum or a short note that commits to EU-only telemetry (where requested) that would clear the last compliance gate for our legal team.

Best,
Tim
Attachments: security_questionnaire_filled.pdf (responses)
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Walsh <t.walsh@cleardata.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-14T17:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Processor ownership and EU egress path for RDW-2347

Tim — quick update and a proposed path to close:

- We can offer a tenant-scoped config that enforces EU-only telemetry routing. That setting is available today and we will include a clause in the DPA addendum to commit to EU-only telemetry for named tenants.
- CacheWave contract & SCCs are expected next week; I will send the vendor attestation and SOC2 link when received.
- Regarding APAC personnel/legal entities: EdgeFlow (being decommissioned) has APAC presence; none of the active EU-edge processors (EuroEdge, our EU KMS provider) have operational personnel in APAC that would access EU tenant data. We've reflected this in the attached DPA draft.

Link to DPA addendum draft and evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-cleardata-dpa
Attachments: DPA_Cleardata_Signed.pdf (signed DPA draft), subprocessor_matrix_v2.xlsx (updated)

Next steps:
- Jordan/legal to confirm wording in DPA addendum, I can get a countersigned version out once legal signs off.
- Tim — please confirm if the EU-only telemetry setting is sufficient for your compliance gate and we'll mark RDW-2347 ready for procurement.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Lead, Account Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
